name: orb_momentum_v22
mechanism: NIFTY's first 20 minutes (09:15-09:35) is the overnight information absorption window — FII/DII desks reconcile gap risk, news flow, and SGX Nifty signals before committing directional capital. Large institutional participants use this range to calibrate their day's TWAP/VWAP benchmarks and avoid entering until the range stabilizes. When price closes above the ORB high with VWAP confirmation, it signals that buy-side institutional flow has overwhelmed the supply ceiling created during the opening range; the executing algo is only partially filled and must continue buying, producing 20-40 spot point continuation moves. A 3-bar (15-second) persistence filter at 5s resolution eliminates the frequent spike-and-retrace noise inherent in index microstructure that would never occur in the original 1-minute framing.
core_signal_oneliner: 20-minute ORB breakout with 3-bar persistence, VWAP alignment, and 10-min relative volume surge
